MyTerminal

This app is part of the cloudy APK fleet and runs on the phone only.

What it does

cloud-myterminal — constellation of three minimally-forked upstream developer apps (Acode code editor / Amaze File Manager / Amaze File Utilities) plus a thin original hub APK.

Where to get it

Install it on your phone from the Cloud Store app, or from the Store tile in the Cloud SuperApp. About the Store.
